title: Mexican Crispy Fish Wrap
description: A crunchy fish wrap with a Mexican twist, featuring crispy battered fish, crunchy lettuce, and a tangy slaw.
instructions: 1. Cut the fish into small pieces and dip into the Mexican batter mix.
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
3. Fry the battered fish until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Remove the fish from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
5. In a separate pan, warm the tortilla wraps over medium heat.
6. Assemble the wraps by placing a piece of crispy fish onto each tortilla, followed by a spoonful of coleslaw, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a slice of tomato.
7. Drizzle with tartar sauce, if using.
9. Garnish with additional cilantro and a lime wedge, if desired.
